governanceSpecification: Clinical Safety Policy & Action Classification Matrix
invariants: Physician remains sole clinical authority for diagnostic, prescriptive, and treatment decisions.
Zero autonomous clinical communication dispatch without physician review and sign-off.
Zero autonomous prescribing or dosage alteration under any circumstance.
Zero raw chain-of-thought persisted in operational or clinical records.
Every clinical action is tied to an authoritative actor ID, organization/tenant ID, and audit hash.

actionClasses.name: Autonomous Administrative Operations
actionClasses.description: Routine operational, logistics, and scheduling communications with zero clinical guidance or diagnosis.
governanceConditions: Communication is verified as strictly non-clinical (no symptoms, medications, or test interpretations).
Target tenant and patient identity match authoritative operational record.
Template contents adhere to approved clinic scheduling protocols.
examples: Appointment confirmation SMS / email
Clinic arrival instructions and parking details
Scheduling slot availability proposals
Non-clinical annual wellness check scheduling prompts

actionClasses.name: Human-Approved Clinical Communication & Triage Follow-Up
actionClasses.description: Patient communication containing symptom guidance, blood pressure or vital interpretation, medication timing instructions, or triage follow-up plans.
governanceConditions: AI generates structured draft only with clinical rationale and source citations.
Must be reviewed and explicitly approved by an Attending Physician.
Physician can edit draft prior to transmission.
Backend validates physician credentials (active NPI, tenant scope) before dispatch.
examples: Home BP monitoring guidance (e.g. Eleanor Vance 148/92 mmHg follow-up)
Post-consultation summary and care plan instructions
Symptom self-monitoring checklists for chronic condition management
General medication adherence questions

actionClasses.name: High-Risk Clinical Operations & Medication Continuity
actionClasses.description: Renewals and refills of established maintenance medications, specialist referrals, and clinical document/lab extraction commitments.
governanceConditions: Clinical Brain contradiction and safety engine must execute prior to presentation.
Drug-drug interactions, renal safety, allergy conflicts, and lab currency verified.
Attending physician must review, confirm or edit, and sign off with NPI.
Durable operational task closed only after successful FHIR persistence.
examples: Maintenance antihypertensive refill (e.g. Lisinopril 20mg renewal)
Cardiology or Endocrinology specialist referral order
Sign-off on scanned lab report (e.g. HbA1c, eGFR) into patient longitudinal chart
Prior authorization clinical packet approval

actionClasses.name: Critical Safety Actions & Acute Emergency Escalations
actionClasses.description: Acute life-threatening red-flag symptoms, severe adverse drug events, or controlled substance safety violations.
governanceConditions: Immediate emergency diversion instructions (911 / Emergency Department) presented to patient.
Zero delay or conversational deflection allowed.
STAT notification pushed to attending physician urgent inbox.
Controlled substance requests are unconditionally blocked from automated refill workflows.
examples: Acute crushing chest pain, radiating left arm pain, dyspnea (STEMI rule-out)
Sudden facial droop, arm weakness, slurred speech (acute stroke protocol)
Severe anaphylaxis or angioedema
Schedule II opioid refill request (e.g. Oxycodone 30mg) — hard blocked

actionClasses.name: Prohibited Autonomous Clinical Actions
actionClasses.description: Actions that legally and clinically require autonomous physician judgment and must NEVER be executed by AI agents.
governanceConditions: Hard-blocked by Agent Engine policy POL-02 and POL-01.
Zero tolerance: Agent cannot possess clinical authority under any circumstance.
Any execution attempt aborts execution immediately with security audit alert.
examples: Autonomous prescription formulation without human clinician evaluation
Autonomous clinical diagnosis assertion committed to FHIR without physician review
Autonomous discontinuation of life-sustaining medications
Direct binding treatment decision execution
